title: Constructive Rational and Exterior-Algebra Certificates for Euclidean Geometry in the Asymptotic Spectrum of Tensors
abstract: We present TENSOR-SPEC-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point algebraic certificate framework and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel verifying the core finite-dimensional algebraic, exterior-algebra, CAT(0) metric, mean-width, and borrowed-wire catalyst invariants underlying OpenAI's November 24, 2026 unrefereed preprint 'Euclidean geometry in the asymptotic spectrum of tensors' (Theorems 1.1 and 1.2). Across 19 constructive Lean 4 theorems (0 sorry, 0 axiom, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings) and 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16), we audit flattening-cut non-additivity (3 > 2*sqrt(2) over Q and F_2), exterior-algebra anticommutation D_j L_i + L_i D_j = delta_{ij} I and Vandermonde/Cauchy-Binet unimodularity, CAT(0) midpoint/quadrilateral bounds, norm rigidity, planar mean-width W(K) = per(K)/2 with convex-hull insertion and submodularity, Proposition 5.2 quadratic degeneration, tagged permutations Tag(h,w), Lemma 8.2 catalyst gaps, Equation (9.1) routing budgets with Proposition 9.3 Bregman progress, and Equation (16.1) in-regime diagonalization gaps. All 16 certificates, 88 pytest checks, and 37 SHA-256 hashes verify deterministically.
